replay.entry: In K1 a desktop is a connection of its own: setVisibleSessions is thread/resume and thread/unsubscribe on that connection, issued by apps/desktop/src/main/protocol/service-route.ts (method === 'setVisibleSessions'), which reads no version; a closed connection detaches its subscriptions (mixdog-app-server/src/server.rs ConnectionHandle drop) and a thread unloads when its last subscriber leaves (mixdog-core-session actor Ctl::Unsubscribed). The recorded values are Node's desktop service registry (one service shared by desktops, client tokens, versioned registrations) and its {kind, sessionId, wire} frames over a scripted host; the core has no shared service or registry, so no case is replayed on replay-k1-session-host-a (see cases).

cases.a restarted desktop can register version: not replayed: the retained service and its registrations are Node's registry; frames are Node delta wires
